name: Default
shortDescription: Web UI and scheduler for restic backups: create or import repositories, run scheduled backups and prune jobs, browse snapshots and restore files.

alerts.message: Authentication is off until setup is completed, and the first visitor sets the instance ID, username and password. Open the app right after deployment and complete the setup.
The container can only reach its own volumes. Use remote repositories (S3, B2, SFTP, rclone) for real backups; /userdata and /repos are volumes inside this stack.
